$comment: Board structure for K41R0N/meal-planner. Synced by .github/workflows/pm-sync.yml on push. Milestones mirror the stages of docs/roadmap/commercial-release.md (map: docs/operating/milestones.md) and match on the key before the first space of the title; `aliases` lets an existing milestone be renamed in place. A `retired` milestone is closed only once it has no open issues. The sync never deletes.

labels.name: type:epic
labels.description: One per roadmap stage; mirrors the stage gate and parents its issues

labels.name: type:feature
labels.description: User- or owner-observable change

labels.name: type:eval
labels.description: Builds or runs an eval from docs/evals/README.md

labels.name: type:research
labels.description: Gathers evidence with the methods in docs/growth/README.md

labels.name: type:decision
labels.description: The owner chooses; agents prepare options and evidence

labels.name: type:bug
labels.description: Behavior differs from an owning contract

labels.name: type:chore
labels.description: Tooling, config or maintenance with no product change

labels.name: track:product
labels.description: Product behavior and flows

labels.name: track:domain
labels.description: packages/meal-domain logic and data contracts

labels.name: track:design
labels.description: Card system, interaction and accessibility

labels.name: track:agent
labels.description: Shared commands, MCP and assistant access

labels.name: track:platform
labels.description: Android, accounts, sync, hosting

labels.name: track:growth
labels.description: Research, positioning and growth measurement inside Stages 2, 4 and 5

labels.name: track:ops
labels.description: Board, CI, evals and operating loops

labels.name: status:needs-plan
labels.description: Needs a plan or sharper acceptance criteria before work

labels.name: status:ready
labels.description: Meets the definition of ready

labels.name: status:in-progress
labels.description: Being worked; WIP limit is three

labels.name: status:in-review
labels.description: Pull request or gate packet awaiting review

labels.name: status:blocked
labels.description: Waiting on a named dependency

labels.name: status:needs-owner
labels.description: Waiting on an owner decision or owner-only action

labels.name: priority:now
labels.description: This cycle

labels.name: priority:next
labels.description: After the current cycle

labels.name: priority:later
labels.description: Parked, with the reason in the issue

labels.name: regression
labels.description: A shipped capability fell below its eval threshold

labels.name: owner-wish
labels.description: Stated by the owner; no milestone covers it yet

milestones.title: S0 · Preserve the working personal foundation
milestones.description: Roadmap stage 0. Gate: document the foundation and verify clean build and backup behavior; no new commercial claims, checkout or public creator-catalog distribution. Source: docs/roadmap/commercial-release.md

milestones.title: S1 · Make recipes and nutrition trustworthy
milestones.description: Roadmap stage 1. Gate: a representative held-out set meets predeclared source-fidelity, ingredient/unit, yield and serving-basis thresholds, with denominators and abstention; no licensed-starter claim for the research seed without rights review. Source: docs/roadmap/commercial-release.md

milestones.title: S2 · Prove the repeatable week and numeric-goal engine
milestones.description: Roadmap stage 2. Gate: held-out week scenarios pass; a supervised pilot shows users can reach a usable second week. Source: docs/roadmap/commercial-release.md

milestones.title: S3 · Add accounts, Android, sync and authoritative entitlements
milestones.description: Roadmap stage 3. Gate: Android device and interrupted-network tests, migration and restore, no cross-user leakage, purchase/expiry/refund webhooks and support exercises in staging; owner, privacy documents, publisher accounts and budget limits before paid users. Source: docs/roadmap/commercial-release.md

milestones.title: S3A · Agent-friendly shared workspace and MCP
milestones.description: Roadmap stage 3A. Shared commands and local bridge alongside stages 1-2; account-backed remote MCP after stage 3. Gate: authorized source-to-shopping scenario in the real app and tested clients, with safety, recovery and cost evidence. Source: docs/roadmap/commercial-release.md

milestones.title: S4 · Closed commercial pilot before broad marketing
milestones.description: Roadmap stage 4. Gate: readiness register signed off; support can recover billing and data incidents; payment and renewal evidence (20/12/8/5 of 30) informs scaling. Source: docs/roadmap/commercial-release.md

milestones.title: S5 · Release and growth, only after the gates
milestones.description: Roadmap stage 5. Android and responsive web with accurate claims, support, export, deletion, attribution and rollback; growth measured before scaling. Source: docs/roadmap/commercial-release.md
